kpis.description_fr: Plus de 10 000 clients mondiaux, dont majorité Forbes Global 100. KPI scale plateforme SaaS sécurité.
kpis.description_en: Over 10,000 customers worldwide including majority of Forbes Global 100. SaaS security platform scale KPI.

kpis.description_fr: CA SaaS abonnements annuels renouvelables - modèle SaaS pur, reconnaissance ratable.
kpis.description_en: Recurring annual SaaS subscription revenue - pure SaaS model, ratable recognition.

kpis.description_fr: Revenus différés (facturé non encore reconnu) - indicateur visibilité revenus futurs SaaS.
kpis.description_en: Deferred revenue - SaaS forward visibility indicator.

kpis.description_fr: Effectif R&D (1262 sur 2625 total) - 48% des FTE en R&D, typique SaaS sécurité. 70% effectif total en Inde.
kpis.description_en: R&D headcount (1262 of 2625 total) - 48% R&D mix, typical security SaaS. 70% of total workforce in India.

kpis.description_en: % revenue from US-billed customers - steadily falling as international mix grows.

kpis_story.description_fr: Plateforme TruRisk étendue (Total Cloud, ITDR, AppSec) en 2024-2025. Pricing modular, ARR cross-sell. Compétition CrowdStrike/Wiz.
kpis_story.description_en: TruRisk platform extended (Total Cloud, ITDR, AppSec) 2024-2025. Modular pricing, ARR cross-sell. CrowdStrike/Wiz competition.

_notes: Pure-play cybersecurity SaaS. Strong subscription model. ARR / NRR not explicitly disclosed in 10-K (typical of less mature SaaS reporting). Deferred revenue serves as proxy.
